svg.text: Schematic of the breadboard wiring | programmed by WCH-LinkE R0-1v3 (1-wire SWIO)
U1: CH32V003J4M6 (SOP-8), VDD = 3.3 V supplied by the WCH-LinkE 3V3 pin; C1 = 0.1 µF across VDD/GND (pins 4 / 2).
Pin 6 (PC2) → R1 2.2 kΩ → gate of Q1 (AO3400 N-MOSFET); R2 10 kΩ pulls the gate down to GND.
Q1 source → GND; drain → LED cathode. LED anode → R3 220 Ω → +3.3 V. Low-side switch: pin HIGH = LED on.
Pin 8 (PD1 / SWIO) → WCH-LinkE SWDIO; WCH-LinkE GND → GND. Pins 1, 3, 5, 7 are not connected.
Datasheet v1.8 lists duplicate SOP-8 pin numbers (PD4/PD5 and PD6/PA1); PD1/SWIO on pin 8 follows the
pin-definition table and matches common J4M6 breakout boards.
